fields.why: CV-005 was bogged due to wet feed material on the COS. There were reports that during an outage that day the sprays were left on without any feed on the belt, resulting in excess water making it onto the COS. While the sprays run in auto they will automatically shut off however if for any reason the sprays are in manual then an alarm would be required to prompt the CRO to turn the spray off.
fields.design:
Add an alarm for when the following conditions are met:
WT-2157 below 10 tph for 30 minutes and XV-2340 or XV-2338 open

The alarm should read "CV-003 spray on without feed – consider turning off" the alarm can be a yellow alarm.
fields.impact: CROs get a yellow alarm if CV-003 sprays stay on with no feed.
